title: set system option kernel cpu isolate-cpus \<cpu-range\>
cmd: set system option kernel cpu isolate-cpus \<cpu-range\>
desc:
Isolates specified CPUs from the kernel scheduler. Isolated cores will
not run regular system processes and are dedicated to applications like
VPP.

The `<cpu-range>` can be:
* Single core: `2`
* Range: `2-5`
* Mixed: `1,3-5,7`

:::{important}
Always reserve at least 2 cores for the operating system to ensure
system stability. For example, on a 4-core system, isolate cores
2-3 for VPP and leave cores 0-1 for the OS.

Assign the first isolated core as the VPP main core and the
remaining isolated cores as VPP worker cores. Ensure that VPP CPU
assignments match the isolated CPU range.
:::

title: set system option kernel cpu nohz-full \<cpu-range\>
cmd: set system option kernel cpu nohz-full \<cpu-range\>
desc:
Enables adaptive-tick mode (NO_HZ_FULL) for specified CPUs. This
causes the kernel to avoid sending scheduling-clock interrupts to CPUs
that have only one runnable task, significantly reducing interrupt
overhead for dedicated workloads like VPP.

Use the same CPU range as configured for `isolate-cpus`.

title: set system option kernel cpu rcu-no-cbs \<cpu-range\>
cmd: set system option kernel cpu rcu-no-cbs \<cpu-range\>
desc:
Offloads Read-Copy-Update (RCU) callback processing from specified
CPUs. This ensures that RCU callbacks do not prevent the specified CPUs
from entering dyntick-idle or adaptive-tick mode, which is essential
for nohz-full functionality.

Use the same CPU range as configured for `isolate-cpus`.

title: gNMI Get (gnmic)
desc: Pull interface counters once over gNMI from an EOS device.

title: gNMI Subscribe sample (gnmic)
desc: Stream interface counters every 10s via gNMI sample subscription.

title: gNMI Subscribe on-change (gnmic)
desc: Receive updates only when a leaf changes (on-change subscription).

title: Enable gNMI server (EOS)
cmd:
management api gnmi
 transport grpc default
 provider eos-native
desc: Enable the on-box gNMI/gRPC transport on Arista EOS.

title: Enable streaming telemetry to collector
desc: Stream state to CloudVision / a gRPC collector via TerminAttr.

title: Model-driven telemetry dial-out (IOS-XE)
cmd:
telemetry ietf subscription 101
 encoding encode-kvgpb
 filter xpath /interfaces-ios-xe-oper:interfaces/interface/statistics
 stream yang-push
 update-policy periodic 1000
 receiver ip address <collector> 57500 protocol grpc-tcp
desc: Periodic gRPC dial-out streaming telemetry subscription on IOS-XE.

title: Streaming telemetry path (NX-OS)
cmd:
telemetry
 destination-group 1
  ip address <collector> port 50001 protocol gRPC encoding GPB
 sensor-group 1
  path sys/intf depth 0
 subscription 1
  dst-grp 1
  snsr-grp 1 sample-interval 10000
desc: Configure NX-OS model-driven telemetry to a gRPC collector at 10s.

title: gRPC streaming telemetry (JTI)
cmd:
set services analytics streaming-server collector address <ip> port 50051
set services analytics export-profile prof reporting-rate 30
desc: Junos Telemetry Interface gRPC export profile (native sensors).

title: gNMI / OpenConfig subscribe
cmd: set system services extension-service request-response grpc clear-text port 32767
desc: Enable the gNMI/gRPC server on Junos for OpenConfig telemetry.

title: gNMI subscribe (SR Linux)
desc: Subscribe to per-interface statistics on Nokia SR Linux over gNMI (port 57400).

title: Enable gNMI server (SR Linux)
cmd:
enter candidate
set / system gnmi-server network-instance mgmt admin-state enable
commit now
desc: Enable the gNMI server in the mgmt network-instance on SR Linux.

title: gNMI server (Cumulus NVUE)
cmd:
nv set system gnmi-server listening-address 0.0.0.0
nv config apply
desc: Turn on the gNMI server on Cumulus Linux via NVUE.

title: gNMI / telemetry container status
cmd:
show feature status | grep telemetry
docker ps | grep telemetry
desc: Verify the gNMI/telemetry (gnmi) container is running on SONiC.

title: gNMI get via gnmic
desc: Query SONiC interface state over gNMI (default telemetry port 8080).

title: sFlow export
cmd:
sflow sample 16384
sflow destination <collector>
sflow run
desc: Enable sFlow sampling and export on EOS.

title: Flexible NetFlow / IPFIX
cmd:
flow exporter EXP
 destination <collector>
 transport udp 4739
flow monitor MON
 exporter EXP
 record netflow ipv4 original-input
interface Gi0/0
 ip flow monitor MON input
desc: Flexible NetFlow with IPFIX (UDP/4739) export on IOS-XE.

title: Inline IPFIX (jflow)
cmd:
set services flow-monitoring version-ipfix template IPv4 flow-active-timeout 60
set forwarding-options sampling instance S family inet output flow-server <ip> port 4739
desc: Inline-jflow IPFIX sampling/export on Junos.

title: sFlow agent
cmd:
set system sflow interface eth0
set system sflow server <collector> port 6343
desc: Configure sFlow export on VyOS.

title: NETCONF over SSH enable
desc: Enable the NETCONF/YANG agent (port 830) on IOS-XE.

title: RESTCONF enable
desc: Enable RESTCONF (HTTPS) on IOS-XE for model-driven config.

title: Guest Shell / on-box Python
desc: Run on-box Python from the IOS-XE Guest Shell container.

title: EEM applet (event automation)
cmd:
event manager applet LINKDOWN
 event syslog pattern "Interface GigabitEthernet0/1, changed state to down"
 action 1.0 cli command "enable"
 action 2.0 syslog msg "Gi0/1 went down"
desc: Embedded Event Manager applet reacting to a syslog event.

title: On-box Python / bash
desc: Enable and run on-box scripting on NX-OS.

title: Commit script / SLAX op
cmd:
set system scripts op file myscript.slax
op myscript
desc: Register and run a Junos op (SLAX/Python) automation script.

title: JET / Python on-box
cmd:
set system scripts language python3
set event-options event-script file handler.py
desc: Enable Python scripting and an event handler on Junos.

title: eAPI (JSON-RPC) enable
cmd:
management api http-commands
 protocol https
 no shutdown
desc: Enable Arista eAPI (HTTPS JSON-RPC) for programmatic control.

title: Config session (commit/rollback)
cmd:
configure session add-vlan
 vlan 200
 name PROD
commit
# or: abort / rollback clean-config
desc: Stage changes in a named config session, then commit or abort — safe automation.

title: JSON-RPC / candidate config
cmd:
enter candidate
set / interface ethernet-1/1 admin-state enable
diff
commit now
desc: Declarative candidate→commit workflow on SR Linux (also exposed via JSON-RPC).

title: REST API admin + token
cmd:
config system api-user
 edit "automation"
  set api-key ENC ...
  set accprofile "super_admin"
 next
end
desc: Create a REST API user/token for FortiGate automation (cmdb/monitor).

title: XML API key
desc: Generate the PAN-OS XML API key used for programmatic config/ops.

title: Config-mode scripting / commit
cmd:
configure
set interfaces ethernet eth1 address 10.0.0.1/24
commit
save
exit
desc: VyOS structured config with atomic commit (HTTP API mirrors this).

title: NVUE REST API apply
cmd:
nv config apply
# REST: PATCH /nvue_v1/ with revisionID then apply
desc: NVUE declarative apply; the same model is exposed over the REST API.

title: ZTP status / cancel
cmd:
show zerotouch
zerotouch cancel
zerotouch disable
desc: Inspect Zero Touch Provisioning state and opt out to a normal boot on EOS.

title: Network Plug-and-Play (PnP) discovery
cmd:
pnp profile pnp-zero-touch
 transport https ipv4 <pnp-server> port 443
desc: Point IOS-XE PnP agent at a controller for day-0 onboarding.

title: ZTP Guest Shell (IOS-XE)
cmd:
# DHCP option 67 -> http://<srv>/ztp.py ; runs in Guest Shell at first boot
show guestshell
guestshell run python3 /flash/ztp.py
desc: IOS-XE day-0 Python ZTP delivered via DHCP option 67.

title: POAP (PowerOn Auto Provisioning)
cmd:
# abort to manual setup at boot prompt:
skip poap
show boot
desc: NX-OS POAP day-0 provisioning; 'skip' drops to the manual setup dialog.

title: ZTP via DHCP
cmd:
set chassis auto-image-upgrade
# DHCP options 150/43 hand off image + config URL at boot
desc: Enable Junos Zero Touch Provisioning (auto image + config from DHCP).

title: ZTP control
cmd:
sudo ztp status
sudo ztp enable
sudo ztp run
sudo ztp disable
desc: Manage SONiC ZTP (DHCP-driven provisioning.json) from the CLI.

title: Cumulus ZTP
desc: Cumulus Linux ZTP: run the ZTP script, check status, or disable.

title: ZTP / auto-boot
cmd:
show system boot
# ZTP pulls config/image via DHCP opt 66/67 + ztp-server
desc: SR Linux Zero Touch Provisioning state at first boot.

title: ZTP / Aruba Central onboarding
desc: AOS-CX day-0: ZTP + Aruba Central activation status.

title: Zero-touch via FortiManager
cmd:
config system central-management
 set type fortimanager
 set fmg <ip>
end
desc: FortiGate zero-touch onboarding through FortiManager / FortiDeploy.

title: Interface breakout 4x25G
cmd:
interface Ethernet1/1
 speed forced 100gfull
interface Ethernet1
# 100G->4x25G:
  speed 25g-4
desc: Break a 100G port into 4x25G on EOS (verify with 'show interfaces status').

title: Show transceiver / DOM
cmd:
show interfaces transceiver detail
show interfaces transceiver dom
desc: Read optic type, Rx/Tx power and DOM thresholds on EOS.

title: Port breakout (NX-OS)
desc: Split a 100G QSFP port into 4x25G on NX-OS.

title: Show transceiver / DOM
cmd:
show interfaces transceiver detail
show hw-module subslot transceiver
desc: Display optic vendor, wavelength and digital optical monitoring values.

title: Breakout (IOS-XE)
desc: Configure a breakout group on IOS-XE platforms that support it.

title: Channelize / breakout
cmd: set chassis fpc 0 pic 0 port 1 number-of-sub-ports 4 speed 25g
desc: Channelize a 100G port into 4x25G sub-ports on Junos.

title: Show optics / DOM
desc: Per-lane Rx/Tx power, bias and temperature for an optic on Junos.

title: Breakout port
cmd:
enter candidate
set / interface ethernet-1/1 breakout-mode num-channels 4 channel-speed 25G
commit now
desc: Declarative 4x25G breakout on SR Linux.

title: Breakout (NVUE)
cmd:
nv set interface swp1 link breakout 4x25G
nv config apply
desc: Break swp1 into 4x25G on Cumulus via NVUE.

title: Split / breakout interface
cmd:
interface 1/1/1
 split
show interface transceiver detail
desc: Enable a split (breakout) interface and read optic DOM on AOS-CX.

title: Show optical / DOM
desc: Per-port transceiver DOM (power/temp) on EXOS.

title: Transceiver / DOM + breakout
cmd:
show interfaces transceiver eeprom
show interfaces transceiver presence
sudo config interface breakout Ethernet0 '4x25G'
desc: Read SFP EEPROM/presence and set a dynamic port breakout on SONiC.

title: Show transceiver (NX-OS)
desc: Optic type and DOM Rx/Tx power for a single NX-OS port.

title: Disable telnet, SSH-only mgmt
cmd:
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 exec-timeout 5 0
ip ssh version 2
desc: Force SSHv2-only management access and idle timeout on VTYs.

title: Harden SSH ciphers / KEX
cmd:
ip ssh server algorithm encryption aes256-gcm aes256-ctr
ip ssh server algorithm mac hmac-sha2-256
ip ssh server algorithm kex diffie-hellman-group14-sha256
desc: Restrict SSH to strong ciphers/MAC/KEX on IOS-XE.

title: Control-plane policing (CoPP)
desc: Apply a CoPP policy to rate-limit traffic punted to the control plane.

title: Disable risky services
cmd:
no ip http server
no cdp run
no service pad
service password-encryption
login block-for 60 attempts 3 within 30
desc: Turn off legacy/unneeded services and add login brute-force protection.

title: MACsec (802.1AE) on link
cmd:
interface Gi1/0/1
 macsec
 mka policy MKA-POL
 mka pre-shared-key key-chain KC
desc: Enable MACsec link-layer encryption with MKA on a switchport.

title: SSH-only, no telnet
cmd:
delete system services telnet
set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh ciphers aes256-gcm@openssh.com
desc: Remove telnet and pin SSHv2 with a strong cipher on Junos.

title: Loopback / control-plane filter (lo0)
cmd: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input PROTECT-RE
desc: Protect the Routing Engine by filtering traffic to lo0 (control plane).

title: MACsec connectivity association
cmd:
set security macsec connectivity-association CA1 pre-shared-key ckn <hex> cak <hex>
set security macsec interfaces ge-0/0/1 connectivity-association CA1
desc: Configure MACsec with a pre-shared CAK/CKN on a Junos interface.

title: Management SSH hardening
cmd:
management ssh
 cipher aes256-gcm@openssh.com
 idle-timeout 5
no service telnet
desc: Strong SSH ciphers, idle timeout and telnet disabled on EOS.

title: Control-plane ACL (CoPP)
cmd:
system control-plane
 ip access-group COPP-IN in
desc: Apply a control-plane ACL to protect the EOS CPU.

title: Admin access + strong crypto
cmd:
config system global
 set admin-ssh-grace-time 30
 set strong-crypto enable
 set admintimeout 5
end
desc: Enforce strong crypto, short admin timeout and SSH grace on FortiGate.

title: Restrict admin to trusted hosts
cmd:
config system admin
 edit admin
  set trusthost1 10.0.0.0 255.255.255.0
 next
end
desc: Lock the FortiGate admin account to a management subnet.

title: Disable telnet/HTTP mgmt
cmd:
set deviceconfig system service disable-telnet yes
set deviceconfig system service disable-http yes
desc: Disable insecure management services on Palo Alto.

title: Permitted management IPs
desc: Restrict which subnets may reach the PAN-OS management interface.

title: SSH-only + login hardening
cmd:
no telnet-server
ssh server vrf mgmt
aaa authentication login default group radius local
desc: Disable telnet, bind SSH to the mgmt VRF, and require AAA login on AOS-CX.

title: Disable telnet, enforce SSH
cmd:
undo telnet server enable
stelnet server enable
ssh server cipher aes256_gcm
desc: Turn off telnet and enforce STelnet (SSH) with strong ciphers on VRP.

title: SSH server + ACL
cmd:
enter candidate
set / system ssh-server network-instance mgmt admin-state enable
commit now
desc: Restrict SSH to the mgmt network-instance on SR Linux.

title: SSH hardening
cmd:
set service ssh disable-password-authentication
set service ssh ciphers aes256-gcm@openssh.com
delete service telnet
desc: Key-only SSH with a strong cipher and no telnet on VyOS.

title: Disable insecure services
cmd:
/ip service disable telnet,ftp,www,api
/ip service set ssh port=2200
desc: Disable telnet/FTP/HTTP/API and move SSH off the default port on RouterOS.

title: Host SSH daemon hardening
cmd:
sudo sed -i 's/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sudo systemctl reload ssh
desc: Disable SSH password auth on a Linux network host.
